title: The Wonderful news from the hospital
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：wonderful　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wonderful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the grandmother wrote of ① a wonderful news from the hospital in the diary, and everybody in the courtyard said at once that it was ② more wonderful than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grandmother, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the wonderful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most wonderful news from the hospital anybody in the courtyard had ever seen, or so the diary for February 1986 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too wonderful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the wonderful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a wonderful match on Saturday, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as wonderful as the match on Saturday they had once had in the old courtyard. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was wonderful or not, and he said so.

By 1999 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was ⑦ something wonderful, and nothing besides. The child from the next courtyard called the whole plan ⑧ quite wonderful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the diary kept the names of the wonderful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2002, without complaint, she wrote of another wonderful news from the hospital in the same diary, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more wonderful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most wonderful match on Saturday in the whole courtyard, she said in 2004, was the one she could never quite name; the wonderful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 极好（前置定语 a wonderful news from the hospital：1992 年祖母在日记里记下的那件极好的好消息）
B. adj. 极好／精彩（比较级 more wonderful than：文中两处，一处比医院传来的好消息，一处比预想）
C. adj. 极好／精彩（最高级 the most wonderful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 极好（表语 too wonderful to do：母亲觉得它太极好，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 精彩（前置定语 a wonderful match on Saturday：叔叔把整件事称作一桩精彩的比赛）
F. adj. 精彩（同级比较 as wonderful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩周六精彩的比赛相比）
G. adj. 精彩（后置定语 something wonderful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 精彩（受程度副词修饰 quite wonderful：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a wonderful news from the hospital
the most wonderful news from the hospital anybody
The most wonderful match on Saturday in

answers.why: wonderful 意为“极好”，1992 年祖母在日记里记下的是“一件极好的好消息”，此处作前置定语 a wonderful news from the hospital。
wonderful 意为“极好”，此处用比较级 more wonderful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
wonderful 意为“极好”，日记上 二月 那行字说它是院子里最极好的一件，故用最高级 the most wonderful news from the hospital。
wonderful 意为“极好”，母亲认为这件东西“太极好了，谁也用不上”，too wonderful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
wonderful 意为“精彩”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩精彩的比赛”，此处作前置定语 a wonderful match on Saturday。
wonderful 意为“精彩”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩周六精彩的比赛一样精彩”，同级比较用 as wonderful as。
wonderful 意为“精彩”，日记上那半行字要的是“精彩的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something wonderful。
wonderful 意为“精彩”，邻院子来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当精彩”，quite 修饰原级 wonderful。
wonderful 意为“精彩”，2002 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要精彩”，故用比较级 more wonderful than。
wonderful 意为“精彩”，母亲 2004 年说的是“整个院子里最精彩的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most wonderful match on Saturday。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1992 年，祖母在日记里记下了一件极好的好消息。（a wonderful news from the hospital）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更极好。（more wonderful than …）
母亲觉得它太极好，谁也用不上。（too wonderful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩精彩的比赛。（a wonderful match on Saturday）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩周六精彩的比赛一样精彩。（as wonderful as …）
到了 1999 年，日记上只剩半行字：要的是一件精彩的东西。（something wonderful）
answers: In 1992 the grandmother wrote of a wonderful news from the hospital in the diary.
Everybody said it was more wonderful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too wonderful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a wonderful match on Saturday.
He said nobody would call it as wonderful as the match on Saturday they had once had.
By 1999 the diary asked for nothing but something wonderful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wonderful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the grandmother wrote of a wonderful news from the hospital in the diary, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most wonderful news from the hospital in the courtyard, or so the diary says.
My mother thought it too wonderful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a wonderful match on Saturday, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next courtyard called the plan quite wonderful, and everybody laughed.
The wonderful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
